api_service.docs.auth_body: Create a token in your account settings and send it with every request:
api_service.docs.conventions_body: Lists take limit and offset and answer with next_offset (null on the last page). Send an Idempotency-Key header with a POST to make retries safe. Pages and canvases answer with an ETag; send it back as If-Match to refuse an update when someone changed them in between (412). Every answer carries X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset.

api_service.webhooks.delivery_hint: Deliveries are sent right after the change; failed ones are retried by a background job with growing delays. Deliveries are kept for 30 days.
api_service.webhooks.intro: Webhooks tell other services about changes in the wiki: each event is sent as a signed JSON POST (X-BananaWiki-Signature, HMAC-SHA256) and retried with growing delays when it fails. Payloads carry ids, titles and names, never page content, ticket descriptions, comments or canvas content; private boards and canvases are identified by id only.
